worlds.label: AI, software & cloud
worlds.summary: An AI service feels like software. Behind it are physical systems that compute, store information, move data and deliver power.

steps.label: Run the workload
steps.task: Train a model or serve an inference request.
steps.explanation: Processors execute the workload. The software experience depends on the hardware system and how efficiently it is used.
steps.economic_question: How much revenue is supported by the computing platform, and what is needed to sustain it?

steps.label: Keep information close
steps.task: Feed the processors with model weights and data.
steps.explanation: Memory and storage keep information available to the computing system. Capacity and data movement belong in the story alongside processing.
steps.economic_question: How does memory demand translate into investment and cash generation across reporting years?

steps.label: Move the data
steps.task: Connect processors, servers and storage.
steps.explanation: A distributed workload needs information to move between devices. Networking is part of the system, not a separate software abstraction.
steps.economic_question: Where is value captured as systems scale beyond one processor?

steps.label: Keep the system supplied
steps.task: Deliver usable power to the computing equipment.
steps.explanation: Power-delivery electronics support the computing load. This layer makes the physical infrastructure behind a software service visible.
steps.economic_question: What capital and operating requirements sit behind the headline demand for AI?

worlds.label: Automotive & electric mobility
worlds.summary: A vehicle is a collection of electronic systems: battery monitoring, motor control, power conversion and information exchange.

steps.label: Watch the battery
steps.task: Monitor cell conditions and coordinate battery operation.
steps.explanation: Battery-management electronics observe cell conditions and support control decisions. This is an illustrative system, not a vehicle-specific design.
steps.economic_question: Which product functions matter as vehicle electrification changes the electronics mix?

steps.label: Turn energy into movement
steps.task: Control the power delivered to the traction motor.
steps.explanation: The traction inverter converts battery-side electrical power into the form needed by the motor. Control and power devices work together.
steps.economic_question: How do power and control portfolios differ from a high-performance computing business?

steps.label: Bring energy on board
steps.task: Convert and regulate power during charging.
steps.explanation: Charging adds another power-conversion task. A semiconductor discussion that only follows processors would miss this part of the vehicle.
steps.economic_question: How much application relevance is disclosed, and how much revenue attribution is still unknown?

steps.label: Keep control signals moving
steps.task: Coordinate sensing and motor-control electronics.
steps.explanation: Control information must pass between electronic subsystems. The chip mix follows the task and its reliability requirements.
steps.economic_question: What evidence would be needed to connect a product portfolio to a named vehicle program?

worlds.label: Civil infrastructure & construction
worlds.summary: Buildings and infrastructure can be sensed, connected and controlled. Digital design tools and physical monitoring are related but distinct layers.

steps.label: Listen to the structure
steps.task: Measure movement, tilt or vibration.
steps.explanation: A structural-monitoring demonstration shows how physical movement becomes electronic data. It does not prove that a named bridge uses these parts.
steps.economic_question: What is demonstrated capability, and what would establish a real deployment?

steps.label: Connect the observations
steps.task: Move measurements from nodes into a connected system.
steps.explanation: Local processing and communications can make sensor information available beyond the measurement point.
steps.economic_question: Which layers of the sensing system create recurring hardware or software needs?

steps.label: Control the building
steps.task: Coordinate ventilation, equipment and other building functions.
steps.explanation: Building automation connects sensing and control to physical equipment. HVAC is one example of an electronic control loop in a built environment.
steps.economic_question: How do long-lived industrial systems shape the questions asked of a chip supplier?

steps.label: Explore the design first
steps.task: Visualize and simulate architecture and engineering work.
steps.explanation: Design software uses computing hardware to render and simulate a proposed environment. This is downstream engineering design, distinct from designing a semiconductor.
steps.economic_question: Where does the software layer depend on computing platforms, and what does that prove economically?

worlds.label: Automation & robotics
worlds.summary: A robot links perception, processing, communications and movement in a control loop.

steps.label: Observe and decide
steps.task: Turn sensor information into a machine response.
steps.explanation: Robot electronics combine sensing with processing. Different robot tasks call for different combinations of devices.
steps.economic_question: Which system functions are supported by the supplier’s disclosed portfolio?

steps.label: Move with control
steps.task: Drive motors and coordinate real-time actions.
steps.explanation: Motor control and communications connect a computed decision to physical movement. This overview is not a robot safety design.
steps.economic_question: What must be checked before treating robotics exposure as a measurable financial driver?

worlds.label: Aviation & aerospace
worlds.summary: Aircraft electronics connect sensors, communications and control functions, with reliability central to the engineering task.

steps.label: Read the physical signal
steps.task: Convert remote sensor signals into usable data.
steps.explanation: A flight-control unit may aggregate remote sensor signals. Analog conversion is a different semiconductor task from rendering graphics or training AI.
steps.economic_question: Which requirements shape this product category, beyond headline processing speed?

steps.label: Coordinate a control function
steps.task: Connect sensing, communication and remote actuation.
steps.explanation: TI describes communications and remote control functions in flight-control electronics. No aircraft program or certification is inferred from that portfolio.
steps.economic_question: What documentation would establish qualification or supply to a particular aviation program?

worlds.label: Design & digital engineering
worlds.summary: Architecture, engineering and product visualization use hardware to build digital representations of the physical world.

steps.label: Make an idea visible
steps.task: Render a digital model for review.
steps.explanation: Architectural visualization is a downstream use of computing hardware. It is a separate activity from semiconductor design and fabrication.
steps.economic_question: How does a software workflow depend on hardware and platform capabilities?

steps.label: Test the digital representation
steps.task: Explore a design using engineering simulation.
steps.explanation: Simulation and visualization can inform design decisions. An application guide is evidence of capability, not evidence of a customer’s achieved savings.
steps.economic_question: What usage or customer evidence would support an economic impact claim?

worlds.label: Energy & utilities
worlds.summary: Conversion, sensing and communications connect semiconductor devices to power systems and utility infrastructure.

steps.label: Convert electrical energy
steps.task: Manage conversion in storage or solar-energy systems.
steps.explanation: Energy systems use power electronics and control to manage electrical conversion. This overview is not a grid-design specification.
steps.economic_question: Which parts of the supplier’s portfolio are relevant to energy-system investment?

steps.label: Measure and connect
steps.task: Observe energy use and infrastructure conditions.
steps.explanation: Smart meters and grid monitoring add sensing and data exchange to the power-system picture.
steps.economic_question: How would disclosed end-market exposure be distinguished from an analyst’s demand assumption?

worlds.label: Healthcare & medical equipment
worlds.summary: Electronic medical equipment combines measurement, processing and control. This is an industry view, not clinical or device-design advice.

steps.label: Capture a measurement
steps.task: Turn a physical or electrical signal into electronic information.
steps.explanation: Patient-care electronics use sensing and processing functions. The suitability of a specific component for a device requires separate engineering evidence.
steps.economic_question: What application capability is actually documented?

steps.label: Support equipment operation
steps.task: Coordinate monitoring, alarms and equipment functions.
steps.explanation: Control electronics support medical equipment operation. Portfolio examples do not establish clinical performance or regulatory approval.
steps.economic_question: What further evidence would be needed before making a clinical or commercial claim?

worlds.label: Communications & everyday devices
worlds.summary: Phones, communications infrastructure and consumer devices combine computing, radio interfaces and embedded control.

steps.label: Exchange information
steps.task: Connect a device to another device or a network.
steps.explanation: The SIA end-use overview identifies communications as an application category spanning phones and network equipment.
steps.economic_question: Which end-market disclosures would connect a particular company to this demand?

steps.label: Run the everyday device
steps.task: Process inputs and coordinate device functions.
steps.explanation: Consumer electronics use several chip functions together. This overview deliberately does not assign an unverified supplier to a particular product.
steps.economic_question: What is the difference between a common chip category and a verified supplier relationship?

comparability.periods: NVIDIA FY2025 ends 26 Jan 2025; TSMC CY2024 ends 31 Dec 2024. Prior periods also differ; no calendar alignment is inferred.
comparability.currency: NVIDIA USD millions; TSMC TWD thousands. Ratios are calculated within each company. No FX conversion or addition of revenues across supply-chain layers.
comparability.accounting: NVIDIA US GAAP earnings-release data and TSMC Taiwan IFRS annual-report tables. Operating cash-flow classifications are not harmonized.
comparability.capital: NVIDIA purchases include PPE and intangibles; its residual also subtracts related principal payments. TSMC uses annual-report capital expenditures, without assuming identical asset, lease or intangible scope.
comparability.interpretation: A two-period descriptive comparison, not a causal test, full-cycle study, standardized FCF ranking, valuation or forecast.

definitions.operating_cash_flow_margin: Reported operating cash flow / revenue × 100. Cash-flow classifications differ between accounting frameworks.
definitions.capex_operating_cash_flow: Disclosed capital spending / operating cash flow × 100. Company-specific spending scope; not a standardized capital intensity ranking.
definitions.revenue: Reported annual revenue; no currency conversion.
definitions.revenue_growth: (Annual revenue / prior annual revenue - 1) × 100. Prior end dates must be 350–380 days apart.
definitions.capex_revenue: Purchases of property, equipment and intangible assets / revenue × 100. Intangibles included; not comparable to PPE-only capex.
definitions.operating_cash_flow: Reported net cash provided by operating activities.
definitions.free_cash_flow: Operating cash flow less purchases AND principal payments related to property, equipment and intangible assets. NVIDIA release definition; non-GAAP measure.
definitions.free_cash_flow_margin: Free cash flow (including capital principal payments) / revenue × 100.

evaluation.kind: Deterministic local financial-tool and hybrid-retrieval development checks; no live LLM or investment-performance assessment
evaluation.research_workflow_comparison: not implemented; no agent score reported
evaluation.scope_note: Source resolution is checked; citation presence does not prove support for arbitrary generated claims. Restatement/conflict/injection protections are also tested separately in pytest.
